Subject: Alliance opportunity at EdgeCon — proposal for live demo tracks

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick chat earlier. CloudOptic would love to partner with Redwood at EdgeCon (Dec 6-8) — we talked through two opportunities: 1) a shared "Live Demo" track (20-min live co-demos + 10-min audience Q&A) across two days, and 2) a joint booth sponsorship with a rotating demo schedule.

High level asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood speaker(s) for two demo slots (we can host the infrastructure)
- Decide on booth headliner sponsorship level (we can cover lighting/AV if Redwood covers lead-gen code)
- Sign SOW for joint promotion and logos by Nov 23 so we can meet the event marketing deadline

I've attached a short sponsorship SOW and a sample run-of-show. If this sounds good, would you loop in the right members of your events team and legal?

Best,
Nikhil Varma
Head of Partnerships, CloudOptic

Attachments: Sponsorship_SOW_Draft.pdf, Sample_RunOfShow.pdf

Hi Nikhil — great to meet earlier and appreciate the clear asks.

We're enthusiastic about the co-demo track and joint booth. Quick confirmations:
- Redwood will provide two speakers: myself (intro/partner framing) and Sergio for the technical demo.
- We'll take the headliner sponsorship slot if CloudOptic can cover the AV kit for both demo stages.
- Legal: please send the SOW over to partners-legal@redwood.com (cc'd below) — we'll try to get a mark by Nov 19.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sergio to draft a proposed demo schedule and a 1-page joint slide template (shared deck).
2) Laura to own marketing cadence: blog swap + booth promo cadence + social copy.
3) Exchange a demo-access account (read-only) for CloudOptic to test integrations with our hosted demo model.

Can you confirm: what environment (prod-like / sandbox) do you need for the demos, and do you have any AV spec constraints?

Thanks — I will add this to HubSpot and tag the deal (DO-98432).

—Marissa

Hi all — attaching first pass: JointDeck_v1.pptx and DemoSchedule_2026-12-06.xlsx (timeline by slot). Main notes:
- Two live demo sessions on Dec 7 (11:00-11:30 & 15:00-15:30). Each slot: 8 min partner intro, 12 min live integrated workflow, 10 min Q&A.
- Backup: pre-recorded short clip if network hits.
- AV needs: wired HDMI, 2x lav mics, confidence monitor.

Open items I flagged in the deck:
- Which model/endpoint will be used for the live integration? (redwood-hosted or partner-hosted?)
- Access: CloudOptic needs read-only API key scoped to a demo model + sample dataset. We can create a short-lived key and rotate it post-event.

Marissa, Laura — if this schedule works I can update the slide kit for marketing.

Thanks,
